headline: 美中台貿易緊張再起，Qualcomm漲價衝擊供應鏈

sections.label: 追蹤議題更新
entries: • **台海局勢**：美學者倡議由「戰略模糊」轉向「結構性模糊」，主張華府應對北京灰色地帶施壓採取對等反制手段 https://news.nextapple.com/international/20260730/C11A3FA43FADBFF502651BE7788AC537
• **Ambarella/Qualcomm動態**：Qualcomm Q3財報獲利年減25%，因Apple自研C2 modem提前問世，非手機業務（含AI/車用）將成新成長動能，9月起調漲晶片價格 https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/qualcomm-q3-2026-earnings-profit-120521329.html
• **NVIDIA Jetson edge AI**：Jetson平台獲選為Lunar Outpost月球車運算核心，搭載CUDA-X libraries執行自主導航與地圖建構，展現edge AI在極端環境應用潛力 https://engineering.com/lunar-outpost-uses-nvidia-computing-for-moon-missions
• **Hikvision動態**：Hikrobot於Automation Expo發表Hikpad AMR與新一代機器視覺產品，深化工業自動化與機器視覺布局 https://timestech.in/hikrobot-debuts-hikpad-amr-at-automation-expo

sections.label: AI 零售 / 餐飲 / Hotel 應用趨勢
entries: • **零售防損AI化**：AI詐欺手法同步升級，零售業者面臨更精準、自動化的詐騙攻擊，需升級AI風控與異常偵測系統以對應新型態損失 https://retail-insight-network.com/features/the-ai-fraud-wave-retailers-must-prepare-for
• **貨架智慧化**：Instacart整合Arpalus貨架掃描技術，透過電腦視覺即時監控貨架狀態，提升生鮮雜貨庫存準確度，反映零售業從結帳延伸至上游庫存管理的AI布局趨勢 https://trendhunter.com/trends/ai-shelf-intelligence

• **智慧購物車崛起**：英國Morrisons於Preston門市試行Instacart Caper Cart智慧購物車，標誌北美業者跨大西洋拓展AI零售硬體，購物車級AI視覺成self-checkout以外新戰場 https://retailtechinnovationhub.com/home/2026/7/29/two-thumbs-up-for-morrisons-as-grocery-retailer-tests-out-instacart-smart-trolleys-in-preston-store

sections.label: 科技產業（安防 / 半導體）
entries: • **先進封裝競爭**：Unimicron指出Intel EMIB-T要到2027年才量產，TSMC CoWoS產能吃緊下，第二供應來源需求增溫，加劇封裝產業競爭格局 https://www.digitimes.com/news/a20260730PD212/packaging-cowos-unimicron-tsmc-production.html

• **歐盟AI超級工廠計畫**：歐盟啟動全歐7座AI Gigafactories計畫，投資規模上看1.12兆，用以訓練先進AI模型並強化歐洲運算能量 https://technews.tw/2026/07/31/eu-launches-ai-gigafactories-call-to-boost-europes-computing-capacity/
• **WAIC 2026觀察**：DIGITIMES於2026世界人工智慧大會觀察到汽車產業正從軟體定義車輛轉向AIDV（AI-Defined Vehicle），physical AI趨勢成形 https://www.digitimes.com/news/a20260730PD229/2026-digitimes-waic-automotive-industry-chips.html

entries: • **GPT-5.6效能優化**：OpenAI發表GPT-5.6，強調更佳的價格效能比，協助企業以更低成本大規模部署AI workflow https://openai.com/index/advancing-the-price-performance-frontier-with-gpt-5-6
